title: Study lineage and final disposition
alt_text: Eight-step lineage from the preserved P-BREVE-01 no-go through the R2 intervention, serving control, evaluator audits, and final no-release disposition.

title: Signed one-epoch reasoning reduction
alt_text: Grouped bars for seeds 1729 and 2718 show SFT-only, full one-epoch SFT plus DPO, and the marginal DPO increment. Positive values mean fewer tokens; the plus 20 percent target was not reached at both seeds.

title: Serving-time effort control
alt_text: Log-scale comparison of untrained base at xhigh and medium effort. Restricted mean reasoning length fell from 6,407 to 608 tokens and tokens per strict success fell from 21,401 to 944; cap exhaustion was observed at 65 percent versus zero of 20 episodes.

title: Evaluator qualification and failure surface
alt_text: Horizontal bars compare false-accept rates: 24 of 24 shortcuts passed the original bank; 154 of 322 passed replacement runtime; zero of 322 passed broad certification; 7 of 157 near-miss or partial programs passed; 52 of 1,862 wrong mutants passed the blind mutation audit.

title: Disambiguating the two 21-of-40 quantities
alt_text: Three bars show 19 of 40 tasks with an AST leak, the complementary 21 of 40 with no detected AST leak, and the separate cross-method lower bound of at least 21 of 40 known-flaw tasks, composed from seven prior plus fourteen newly adjudicated tasks.

title: Vinci Eval Integrity 0.1
alt_text: Seven stacked checks cover identity and independence, contract clarity, channel separation, bidirectional discrimination, estimand integrity, production-path binding, and exact-procedure power with independent requalification.
